description: This file defines a Fragment class named LogFragment that manages a LogView and a ScrollView to display logs in an Android app. It inflates the views, handles text changes to auto-scroll, and provides access to the LogView.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that creates a scrolling log view using LogView and manages updates to keep the latest logs visible.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, applying layout parameters, styling, and padding.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the views, sets up a text watcher to auto-scroll on new log entries, and returns the root view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance used in this fragment.
